title.zh: 将菲律宾国家铁路公司的公司存续期再延长五十年，并进一步修订第4156号共和国法（经修正，即《设立菲律宾国家铁路公司、规定其权力、职能与职责并为其运营提供必要资金》）的法案
title.en: An Act Extending the Corporate Life of the Philippine National Railways for Another Fifty (50) Years, Further Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 4156, as Amended, Entitled "An Act Creating the Philippine National Railways, Prescribing Its Powers, Functions and Duties, and Providing for the Necessary Funds for Its Operation"

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 4156, as amended, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"SECTION 1. Name, Duration and Domicile. – A corporation to serve as the instrumentality of the Government of the Philippines in providing a nationwide railroad and transportation system, is hereby created to be known as the Philippine National Railways, which shall exist for a term of fifty (50) years from the date of approval of this Act and shall be extended for another fifty (50) years, commencing on 20 June 2014. It shall have its main office in the City of Manila, and shall have such branches and agencies within the Philippines as may be necessary for the proper conduct of its business. This Corporation shall be under the Department of Transportation and Communications."
This Act shall take effect immediately following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
